Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ فِيْهِ أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: O Allah, open for me in it the doors of Your grace
And send down upon me in it Your blessings
And grant me success in it to do what pleases You
And let me dwell in it in the midst of Your Paradise
O You who answers the prayers of the distressed
